My Store v1.0.0 (Debug Test Build)
===================================

File: MyStore-v1.0.0-debug.apk
Package: com.mystore.app

Important Note:
- This APK is signed with the Android debug key for immediate testing on your phone.
- When you later publish v1.0.1+ via GitHub Actions with your permanent signing key
  (see README.md), Android will require uninstalling the debug test build once before
  installing the permanently signed release build (because the signing certificates differ).
- All future releases built with your permanent key will update seamlessly in place.
